CREATE TABLE knowledge_artifacts (
    artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact UUID', 
    knowledge_base_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owning knowledge base ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
    artifact_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact type: briefing or mind_map' DEFAULT 'briefing', 
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Artifact title' DEFAULT '', 
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Lifecycle status' DEFAULT 'queued', 
    task_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Related task ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
    assistant_subtask_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Related assistant subtask ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
    content TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generated content; empty means unavailable', 
    source_document_ids JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Source document ID list', 
    generation_config JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generation configuration', 
    error_message VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Failure message; empty means no error' DEFAULT '', 
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creator user ID; 0 means unset' DEFAULT '0', 
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Generation attempt number' DEFAULT '1', 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Creation time' DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last update time' DEFAULT now(), 
    PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id)
)CHARSET=utf8mb4 ENGINE=InnoDB COMMENT='Knowledge base generated artifacts'
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_artifacts_kb_created ON knowledge_artifacts (knowledge_base_id, created_at, artifact_id)
